•	Work closely with the Brands team & recruitment marketing in effectively establishing communication strategies that attract diverse 4D talent to the business.

•	Ensure all recruiting practices comply with the regulations, both internal and external. Research and translate trends into creative, innovative practices; maintain a strong understanding of how trends and the competitive landscape affect the business; and identify the most suitable recruiting approaches to support high-performance hiring. 
•	Ensure that 4D diversity targets are exceeded by having ready-to-go talent banks of local talent ready to hire. 

Analytics

Use this information to identify trends and adjust recruiting strategies to optimize recruitment outcomes.
